definitions.coverage: Export overlap_coverage and promotion_service_coverage use ALL successful foreground anchor demand D. Useful fraction uses ALL returned payload anchor P. Not renamed a node hit rate.
definitions.node_counts: Reported NodeAnchor/RootAnchor kinds, with returned-node type evidence supplementing demanded ID type. Generic unprefetched Anchor would remain unclassified and can undercount node-only D. This source limitation is disclosed separately from the observed kinds below.
definitions.service: Actual nonplanning FG promote_raw success of same Session/UID, inside a successful demand-call interval and after non-discarded return. Witness raw line/record hashes validated; not exact insertion readiness or saved latency.
definitions.unused: P minus observed successful demand; node-unused is an observational lower bound. Neither implies semantic not-needed/filter-only white read. Predicate/ownership/id accesses are valid demand.
definitions.precision_regime: One separate instrumented capture per57cells, not primary n5 or timing sample.

conclusion: No generic Anchor demands occurred in these57 captures; no observed generic-kind node undercount. Dnode is exactly type-classified for this data, but differs from ALL D due to explicit EdgeAnchor demand in IssueDesk and HelpQueue. Keep original export rates ALL-anchor; separately named NODE-only ratios below are derivative counts, n1.
